terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.draft: Version: draft (to be reviewed by legal before the official terms go live)
terms.s1p: Wishly is a platform for creating wishlists, sharing links, and letting friends and family claim and give items. The actual purchase, shipping and handover between the giver and the list owner are handled by the two of them; the platform does not handle goods or payments.
terms.s2l1: Do not post content that is fraudulent, inappropriate, infringing, or that exposes other people's personal data.
terms.s2l2: Do not use automation to claim in bulk or disrupt the service.
terms.s2l3: If you find content that breaks the rules, use "Report this list" at the bottom of the list page. After manual review it may be taken down.
terms.s3p: Browsing a shared link does not require registration, but giving a gift (claiming an item) requires signing in. One person can have only one active claim per item, and can change the quantity or cancel at any time; a gift that has been delivered can't be cancelled.
terms.s4p: The service is provided as is, and we do not guarantee uninterrupted operation. The platform is not liable for disputes arising from list content, third-party product links or transactions between the parties, but will cooperate in handling content that breaks the rules.
terms.s5p: Changes to the terms are posted on this page. Continuing to use the service means you agree to them.
terms.s6p: For questions or appeals about the service, your account, points or a takedown, email us and include your account ID (copy it from Settings):

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.draft: Version: draft (to be reviewed by legal before the official version goes live)
privacy.collectH: Notice on personal data collection (when giving a gift)
privacy.c1: What we collect: nickname (required), contact info (optional), email (optional), message (optional).
privacy.c2: Purpose: so the list owner knows who will give which items and can contact you; your email is used to send the confirmation and the "Manage my gifts" link.
privacy.c3: Who sees it: your nickname and contact info are visible only to the list owner; your email is never shown to other visitors or to the owner. If the owner turns on "Show givers" and it is not during a surprise lock, other visitors can see your nickname.
privacy.c4: Leaving these blank does not stop you from giving, but you need to leave an email to recover your gift history after switching phones.
privacy.deviceP: To recognize you in "My gifts", we store a random identifier (localStorage and cookie) and the nickname you last used in your browser. LINE's built-in browser may clear this data, so we recommend opening the site in your default browser. When you open a shared link we also store a random viewing identifier in your browser's localStorage, used to count unique visitors.
privacy.viewP: When you open a shared link without being signed in, we record your IP address, device type and browser information (User-Agent), the country and city derived from your IP, the referring site's domain, and a random identifier stored in your browser. The purpose is usage analytics and abuse prevention. These records are kept long term, with no fixed deletion date. Admin reports show only aggregate numbers, never IP addresses.
privacy.rightsP: You can change your nickname in "My gifts", or choose "Delete my nickname and contact info": we clear your nickname, contact info and email, and keep the gift record as "Deleted guest" so the list owner can reconcile. Emails have a one-click unsubscribe link in the footer.
privacy.reportP: Reports are reviewed manually and the list owner is not told who reported. To prevent abuse we use Cloudflare Turnstile and rate-limit by IP.
privacy.loginP: To prevent brute-force attacks, when a sign-in fails we record the email and IP address used. This is used for temporary lockouts and human verification, and in aggregate for operational monitoring; records are deleted automatically after 365 days.
